before: Consecutive local numbering journals could project later insertions against a stale directory-member order, leaving another participant with numbering definitions after counter instances.
after: A journal that edits a directory-member root refreshes its shared view before projecting insertion indexes and refuses an unavailable or incomplete view.
reason: The writer uses the existing journal operations and shared format with corrected insertion positions. Released participants read those operations unchanged; no materialization rule or stored schema changes.
